info.name: SyRide — All APIs (Merged)
info.description: Merged from 4 collections: Admin Dashboard API, Admin APIs, Support Agent Staff APIs, System-Admin APIs. 16 duplicated requests removed (staff auth x6, wallet x7, ban/unban x3). Sections: 1 Authentication, 2 Admin Dashboard (/admin, bearer {{access_token}}), 3 Support Agent (/staff), 4 Admin (/staff), 5 System Admin — all /staff sections use bearer {{staff_token}}.

request.description:
Authenticate as an admin. On success, access_token and refresh_token are saved automatically to collection variables.

Accepts username OR email + password.

Returns:
- tokens.access_token
- tokens.refresh_token
- admin.type (system_admin | sycash)
- admin.email, name, phone
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token. New access_token is saved automatically.
Revokes all refresh tokens for the authenticated admin. Requires a valid access token.

item.name: Auth — Staff / Admin / System-Admin (/staff)
item.description: Shared authentication for support agents, admins, and system admins (all roles log in via /staff/login with their own credentials). Login/refresh save {{staff_token}} / {{staff_refresh_token}} automatically. Duplicated auth requests from the "Admin APIs" and "System-Admin APIs" collections were removed in favor of these.

request.description:
GET /staff/complaints
Filters: status, type, date, user_id, per_page, page
Status values: pending | in_review | resolved | closed
Type values: trip_safety | driver_behavior | passenger_behavior | ride_cancellation | financial_issue | account_issue | technical_issue | other
Date values: last_7_days | last_30_days

exec: console.log('✅ Complaint ID saved:', res.data.id, '| Status:', res.data.status);

request.description:
GET /staff/complaints/{id}
Opening a PENDING complaint automatically moves it to IN_REVIEW and assigns it to the authenticated agent.

PATCH /staff/complaints/{id}/open
Manually moves a complaint to in_review status and assigns to the current agent.

PATCH /staff/complaints/{id}/resolve
Marks complaint as resolved and notifies the user.
resolution_notes is required (min 10 chars).

PATCH /staff/complaints/{id}/close
Permanently closes the complaint. resolution_notes required.

POST /staff/complaints/{id}/notes
Adds an internal staff note to the complaint without changing its status.

PATCH /staff/complaints/{id}/respond
Legacy single endpoint. status values: in_review | resolved | closed

POST /staff/trips/{rideId}/cancel

Cancels an entire ride and all its active bookings.
Notifies all affected passengers.

Allowed ride statuses: active | full | awaiting_confirmation
reason: required, min 10 chars

Response includes how many bookings were cancelled.

POST /staff/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel

Cancels a single booking and restores the seats back to the ride.
Notifies the passenger.
If the ride was 'full', it is reverted to 'active'.

Allowed booking statuses: pending | confirmed
reason: required, min 10 chars
Example: cancelling a trip due to a safety complaint.
Example: cancelling a trip due to a financial dispute.
Example: cancelling a booking at the passenger's request via support.

PATCH /staff/complaints/{id}/escalate

Escalates a complaint to the system admin.
Currently routes to the system_admin role (since a dedicated Admin role is not yet implemented).
When the Admin role is ready, this will route to the assigned admin instead.

Only works on open complaints: pending | in_review
reason: required, min 10 chars

The complaint's resolution_notes will be appended with the escalation reason and agent name.

item.name: 5. System Admin — Employee Management
item.description: Requires {{staff_token}} from a system-admin login. (Original collection used {{staff_token}} in folder auth while its login script saved staff_token — a mismatch; both are unified to {{staff_token}} here.)

item.name: Employee Management

request.description:
Returns all employees the authenticated system_admin can see.

System Admin sees: all admins + all support agents.
Admin sees: only support agents they manage.

Each record includes: id, username, first_name, last_name, email, role, is_active, created_by, last_login_at.

Create a new staff employee.

System Admin can create: admin | support_agent
Admin can create: support_agent only

Body fields:
  username   string  required, 3–50 chars, alphanumeric + dash/underscore
  email      string  optional, unique
  password   string  required, min 8 chars
  first_name string  required
  last_name  string  required
  role       string  required — must be a role the requester is allowed to assign

Allowed roles for system_admin: admin, support_agent
Allowed roles for admin: support_agent

response.name: 403 – Role Not Permitted
422 – Validation Error

request.description:
Fetch a single employee by ID.

System Admin can view any employee.
Admin can only view employees they manage (roles below their level).

Set collection variable `employee_id` before calling.

response.name: 403 – Cannot View This Employee

request.description:
Update an employee's profile fields.
Only the fields provided will be updated (PATCH-like behaviour).

Updatable fields:
  first_name  string  optional
  last_name   string  optional
  email       string  optional, must be unique

Note: username and role cannot be changed after creation.
To change a password use the Reset Password endpoint instead.

Set collection variable `employee_id` before calling.

response.name: 409 – Email Already Taken

request.description:
Toggle an employee's active status (active ↔ deactivated).
No request body required.

Deactivated employees:
  - Cannot log in
  - All existing tokens are invalidated immediately

An employee cannot deactivate themselves.
System Admin cannot be deactivated.

Set collection variable `employee_id` before calling.

response.name: 403 – Cannot Deactivate Self or Higher Role

request.description:
Forcefully reset an employee's password.

All active sessions for that employee are invalidated immediately after the reset — they must log in again with the new password.

Body:
  new_password  string  required, min 8 characters

Set collection variable `employee_id` before calling.

response.name: 200 – Password Reset
422 – Password Too Short
403 – Cannot Reset Own or Higher Password

item.description:
Full CRUD for staff employees.

Middleware: staff:system_admin
All routes require a valid System Admin Bearer token.

Role hierarchy enforced server-side:
  system_admin  → can create/manage admin + support_agent
  admin         → can create/manage support_agent only
  support_agent → cannot manage anyone
